# UI/UX Coding Prompt — Landing Page in "Atoms" Theme

## 1. Project Overview & Theme

Build a complete, responsive landing page for a fictional brand (invent a brand name, product, and all copy — never use any real brand name, logo, trademark, or product name). The visual theme is **"Atoms"**: an obsidian monolith in candlelight — a near-black canvas where a single warm champagne accent cuts like a blade through darkness.

**Mood:** Industrial precision, machined titanium under tungsten light. Monochrome discipline: cream for text, gold for emphasis, black for depth. Flat, low-contrast, hairline borders only — no shadows, no glows, no blur. Static and placed, not kinetic.

## 2. Strict Architecture Rules

### 2.1 CSS-First & Zero Inline CSS
- All styling lives in `style.css`. No `style="..."` attributes in HTML.
- Target all design properties via class/ID selectors only.
- HTML must remain clean, semantic, and agnostic of visual styling.

### 2.2 CSS Variables & Theme Tokens
Define all tokens in `:root` (and `.dark` / `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)`). Dark mode is the default and only theme; still provide the `.dark` class and `prefers-color-scheme` media query for persistence via `localStorage` with a visible toggle (`aria-pressed`, `aria-label`).

**Color tokens:**
- `--color-champagne-gold: #c8ad86` — accent headings, category tags, decorative borders; the only chromatic color, used sparingly.
- `--color-candlelight-cream: #fff7dd` — primary text, hairline borders, icon strokes.
- `--color-obsidian-black: #000000` — page canvas, card surfaces, image backgrounds.
- `--color-ember-ash: #66635f` — muted surface variation, secondary backgrounds.

Map to semantic tokens: `--primary: var(--color-champagne-gold)`, `--bg-primary: var(--color-obsidian-black)`, `--bg-secondary: var(--color-obsidian-black)`, `--text-primary: var(--color-candlelight-cream)`, `--text-secondary: var(--color-ember-ash)`, `--text-success`, `--text-error`, `--border-default: rgba(255, 247, 221, 0.2)`, `--border-error`, `--border-success`.

Contrast pairing: light text on dark backgrounds only. No pure white (`#ffffff`) anywhere — use `#fefefe` only if a near-white is absolutely required (it is not here).

**Spacing & shape tokens:**
- `--spacing-4: 4px`, `--spacing-6: 6px`, `--spacing-8: 8px`, `--spacing-10: 10px`, `--spacing-16: 16px`, `--spacing-20: 20px`, `--spacing-24: 24px`, `--spacing-36: 36px`, `--spacing-40: 40px`, `--spacing-44: 44px`, `--spacing-48: 48px`, `--spacing-56: 56px`, `--spacing-60: 60px`, `--spacing-80: 80px`.
- `--radius-sm: 4px`, `--radius-md: 4px`, `--radius-lg: 100px` (tags/pills only).
- `--shadow-sm`, `--shadow-md` defined but unused (no shadows in this theme).
- `--transition-fast`, `--transition-normal`, `--ease-standard`.
- `--z-dropdown`, `--z-modal`, `--z-toast`.

**Typography tokens:**
- `--font-base` bound to Switzer (Google Fonts substitute: Inter, General Sans, or Satoshi). Use Inter via Google Fonts `<link>`.
- `--text-caption: 10px` (line-height 1.2, letter-spacing 0.18px).
- `--text-body: 14px` (line-height 1.4).
- `--text-heading: 44px` (line-height 1.13, letter-spacing -1.85px).
- Body text: weight 400. Labels/tags: weight 500. Headings: weight 400.
- Letter-spacing: -1.85px at 44px, -0.5px at 16px, 0.18px at 10px. No letter-spacing on body text below 16px.

### 2.3 Flexbox & Mobile-First
- All layout via Flexbox. Every flex container defaults to `align-items: center` unless explicitly justified.
- Mobile-responsive out of the box: rows collapse to columns on small viewports. No horizontal scrolling.

### 2.4 Framework
- Tailwind CSS (or clean custom CSS driven by Tailwind `@layer`/`@apply`). Utility classes map back to CSS variables or reusable class names (`.btn`, `.card`, `.input-group`).

### 2.5 Typography & Icons
- Google Fonts (Inter) for text. Google Material Symbols/Icons for all icons. No inline SVGs or local icon files.

## 3. Component Specifications

### 3.1 Buttons
- Default: flex, `align-items: center`, `justify-content: center`, `gap: 0.5rem`, min 44x44px touch target, radius 4px.
- Hover: brightness/shadow shift, `cursor: pointer`.
- Focus: distinct focus ring via CSS variables.
- Active: `transform: scale(0.97)`.
- Loading: disabled interactions, CSS spinner or animated Material Icon, no dimension distortion.
- Disabled: `opacity: 0.5`, greyscale, `cursor: not-allowed`.
- Success/Error: temporary styles via `--text-success`/`--text-error`.
- Destructive: distinct `.btn-danger` in both themes.

### 3.2 Cards
- Default: flex layout, subtle borders, elevation via `--bg-secondary` and CSS variables. Radius 4px.
- Hover: shadow shift or `transform: translateY(-2px)`.
- Focus-within: highlight border when child link/button focused.
- Loading (skeleton): shimmer animation in CSS, no layout jumps.
- Empty state: Material Icon + guidance text.

### 3.3 Forms & Inputs
- States: Empty, Focused (outline ring), Filled, Valid (success border/icon), Invalid (error border, red text, error icon), Disabled, Read-only.
- Structure: flex container wrapping label, input, error feedback container.

### 3.4 Modal / Popup
- States: Opening, Open, Loading, Success/Error, Closing (CSS transitions).
- Centered flex container, backdrop overlay, Material Icon close button, keyboard focus trapping, close via Esc or overlay click.

## 4. Core UX & Micro-Interactions

- Responsive by default, fluid sizing, no horizontal overflow.
- CSS transitions on all state changes (`transition: var(--transition-normal)`), respecting `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- Accessibility: sufficient contrast in dark mode. Never rely solely on color for state. Semantic HTML5, correct ARIA roles/labels, logical DOM/focus order, full keyboard operability, `aria-live` regions for dynamic feedback.
- Mandatory visual feedback on every click/hover/submission.
- No animations on load — system is static and placed.

## 5. Page Sections (Landing Page)

Build these sections in order, all on the black canvas:

1. **Top Navigation Bar** — fixed, full-width black bar, 36px vertical / 40px horizontal padding. Left: wordmark (fictional). Right: 3 links. Muted surface `#66635f` may be used for secondary zones.
2. **Hero** — vertical stack: large geometric/pixelated logo mark (square tiles in `#c8ad86`, metallic texture, ~40% of hero viewport height, centered, no background), then centered 44px Switzer 400 headline (`#fff7dd`, letter-spacing -1.85px, line-height 1.13, max-width ~600px, 3 lines), then a single ghost text link (12px Switzer 400, `#fff7dd`, inline → arrow, no underline, hover shifts to `#c8ad86`).
3. **Features** — 3-column card grid. Each card: `#000000` surface, 1px hairline border (`#fff7dd` at ~20% opacity or `#c8ad86`), 4px radius, 32px padding. Contains logo area (centered, ~120px tall), company/product name (14px Switzer 500 `#fff7dd`), category tag pill (100px radius, 1px `#c8ad86` border, transparent fill, 10px Switzer 500 `#c8ad86`, letter-spacing 0.18px, padding 4px 10px), description (12px `#fff7dd` at 70% opacity), footer links row separated by 2px gaps with → arrow glyphs.
4. **How It Works** — 3 steps. Large Switzer heading left-aligned. Each step: number/label, title, description. Hairline borders separate steps. Compact spacing (8-16px within, 80px between sections).
5. **Testimonials** — cards with quote, author name, role. Same card styling (hairline border, 4px radius, no shadows).
6. **Pricing** — 3 tiers. Cards with tier name, price, feature list, CTA button. One tier may be highlighted with `#c8ad86` border.
7. **FAQ** — accordion-style questions. Hairline borders. Expand/collapse via CSS/JS.
8. **Final CTA** — centered headline + ghost link or button.
9. **Footer** — secondary links, wordmark, minimal chrome.

## 6. Do's and Don'ts

**Do:**
- Use `#fff7dd` for all primary text and hairline borders on black surfaces.
- Reserve `#c8ad86` exclusively for category tags, accent headings, decorative borders — never as full-surface fill.
- Apply Switzer with tight negative letter-spacing on display sizes.
- Set border-radius to 4px on cards/buttons, 100px on tags/pills only.
- Separate cards/sections with 1px hairline borders, never shadows or background fills.
- Keep vertical rhythm tight: 8-16px between related elements, 80px between major sections.
- Render all icons/arrows in `#fff7dd` or `#c8ad86`.

**Don't:**
- No shadows, glows, or blur for elevation.
- No saturated colors beyond champagne accent.
- No pure white (`#ffffff`) text.
- No background fills on cards/sections — they sit on the black canvas.
- No large border-radius on rectangles (max 4px).
- No letter-spacing on body text.
- No color/position/scale animation on load.

## 7. Deliverables

- Separate `index.html`, `style.css`, `script.js`. No inline `<script>` beyond a single deferred entry-point reference.
- One consistent class-naming convention (BEM) across the entire deliverable.
- No lorem-ipsum-only submissions where real copy is implied; invent fictional but realistic copy for all sections.
- All user-facing copy in English.

## 8. Edit/Interaction Notes

If any requested style change cannot be achieved without adding markup (e.g., missing wrapper or icon element), stop and ask the user rather than silently inserting new HTML. Do not write JS for form validation, popups/modals, or utility functions unless explicitly requested — ask how the user wants it handled.
